headline: Gufic Biosciences explains special window for physical share transfers
hook: Compliance window opens for physical certificates
summary: Gufic Biosciences has outlined the procedure for a special window regarding physical share transfers. This regulatory compliance update affects shareholders holding shares in physical form. Investors holding physical certificates must understand the required documentation and timelines to complete the transfer process. Indian retail investors holding physical shares in the company need to review these guidelines to avoid processing delays.
why_it_matters: Physical share holders must act within the designated transfer window.
